# Copy this file to .dev.vars and fill in values for local CF Workers dev.
# .dev.vars is gitignored — never commit real credentials.
#
# Run: pnpm dev:cf  (from repo root)
# Wrangler reads .dev.vars automatically when running `wrangler dev`.

# Bypasses auth resolution and the setup KV gate so you can hit API routes
# without a real session. Set to "authenticated" in staging/production.
DEPLOYMENT_MODE=local_trusted

# Set by wrangler.toml [vars] — override here only if needed.
DEPLOYMENT_PLATFORM=cloudflare
DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURE=private

# Sidecar Node.js server (runs alongside CF Worker for Node-only operations).
# Leave blank if you haven't configured a sidecar for local dev.
SIDECAR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3101
SIDECAR_API_KEY=dev-local
